fee_notes: Mid-Size Territory (up to 8,499 businesses): $45,500; Standard Territory (8,500-12,000): $59,500; Large Territory (12,001-14,000): $80,500. 10% discount for honorably discharged veterans. Development Fee for area developers: $115,000 (2 units) to $264,500 (5 units) assuming Standard Territories. First-year internet marketing fee: $18,000 (nonrefundable, paid before opening).
raw_excerpt: If you operate a Single FT Business with a territory that contains between 8,500 businesses and up to 12,000 businesses ("Standard Territory"), you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee equal to $59,500. If you operate a Single FT Business with a territory that contains up to 8,499 businesses ("Mid-Size Territory") you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee equal to $45,500. If you operate a Single FT Business with a territory that contains more than 12,000 businesses and up to 14,000 businesses ("Large Territory"), you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee equal to $80,500.
